note: v1 85.029 on seed 0, 85.179 on seed 11: Window Seat, night-bus 2-step (147 s, 136 bpm, F# minor). A shuffled 2-step (kick on 1 and a skip-kick that wanders bar by bar, claps on 2 and 4, off-16th hats swung 0.7, a shaker on a 3-sixteenth cycle across the bar) under a worn F#m9 | Dmaj9 | Bm11 | C#7sus juno loop through wM's tape deck; wordless CHOPS on a song-local voice (one syllable each, la / mo / ye, a falling 9th-5th-3rd cell after the claps); THE STOP, a half-time B section on rhodes over Dmaj9 | E6/9 | C#m7 | Bm9; a beatless breakdown of pads and voices; the last groove with the chops an octave up; vinyl on the master. note: v2, written: THE CHAIN and THE RESAMPLE. In the last groove the chops leave their three-note cell and become a dotted-eighth chain - a syllable every three sixteenths (la / mo / ye cycling over the chord's 9th, 5th and 3rd, an octave up), running across the bar lines against the 2-step, so the voice carries the garage cross-rhythm into the climax (measured: the renders part 84.7-134.8 s). And the half-bar before THE STOP and before the breakdown is grabbed and stuttered on the master in dotted-eighth slices (3/16 x 3, decaying), the resample gesture Harry liked on t4, at the seams where it marks a turn rather than cutting a new section (renders part at 41.5 and 69.7 s). Kept on musical judgment (--keep): compscore seeds 0/11/19/29 (guardrail) v1 85.029/85.179/84.857/85.682 -> v2 84.708/85.140/84.555/85.359 (mean -0.25; rhythm stays 58-59: the kick and clap grid still swamps every cross-rhythm).
